name: Cura
doc: Cura (spell; the act family's framework with Double's short root): one emitter per action - its sound, a glow with swirl sparks and trail motes, four aura players fading in turn, spinning rings, rising sparkles, the light, the target overlay, falling particles; the heal. Its parts are the port's code (FFNx mag025_cura.cpp) run on the program's memory.

copy.doc: Where this effect's copy is in FF8_EN.exe: the program stands in for these functions and uses this memory.

module.doc: The port module whose code runs (its tasks the port's, its parts spawned by them): its memory [from, + size) - in a copy, a block of its own

exe_data.doc: The exe data the effect uses (@key in its values).

magic_buffer.doc: The packet arenas in the magic buffer (odd ticks, even ticks); no morph block

pools.doc: the model players, spawners and the target overlay (the port's)
the glow, sparks, motes, sparkles and particles (the port's)

parts.doc: One per action: its sound, the aura players, the particle emitter, the heal

parts.title: Glow
parts.doc: The glow over the target with its swirl sparks; the sparkles

groups.label: Aura players
